listings.title: Thee Perfect Sale - 4 Days of a PACKED Historic Beverly Estate
listings.description: Thee Perfect Sale is headed to historic Beverly, New Jersey for a packed three-day estate sale inside a circa-1900 home filled with decades of collections, vintage finds, antiques, furniture, jewelry, clothing, glassware, collectibles, craft supplies and more. This is a true treasure-hunting sale with something in nearly every room, closet, cabinet, shelf and workspace — plus a full basement still being uncovered. The homeowners were both makers and collectors. She was a hat maker and milliner, and he was a fly fisherman and fishing lure maker , leaving behind specialized collections of millinery supplies, wooden hat forms, textiles, sewing and needlework materials, fly-fishing items, lure-making supplies and more. SALE HIGHLIGHTS INCLUDE: Vintage & costume jewelry Vintage clothing & accessories Vintage hats Millinery & hat-making supplies Wooden hat blocks / hat forms Fabric, trims, ribbons & notions Sewing supplies Embroidery & needlework supplies DMC embroidery floss Yarn & fiber arts supplies Patterns & craft books Doll-making supplies Vintage dolls & handmade dolls Fly-fishing equipment & accessories Fishing tackle Fishing lure-making supplies & components Handmade fishing-related items Antique furniture Vintage furniture Mid-Century Modern / MCM furniture & décor Asian-inspired furniture & decorative arts Multi-drawer apothecary-style cabinet Vintage bedroom furniture Lamps & lighting Artwork & wall décor Needlepoint & textile art Vintage baskets & woven pieces Pottery & ceramics Vintage glassware Green glass canisters & storage jars China & serving pieces Lenox Vintage kitchenware Cookware & bakeware Kitchen collectibles Linens & textiles Books & cookbooks Garden décor & statuary Home décor & decorative accessories Vintage collectibles Christmas decorations Halloween décor Seasonal & holiday décor PLUS an entire basement packed with more AND WE ARE STILL DIGGING. As we sort, organize and stage the home, we're continuing to uncover vintage clothing, collectibles, antiques, craft materials, furniture, glassware, kitchen items, holiday décor and unexpected finds. listings.description: Fixed 2 Move is pleased to present a varied estate sale in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania. This collection features a wonderful mix of fine traditional furniture, unique global decor, and artwork. Highlighted furnishings include a traditional dark wood secretary desk with a glass-front hutch, an antique tiger maple two-drawer stand, a dark cherry wood media console, a striped upholstered sofa, and a carved dark wood Asian altar cabinet with ornate pierced fretwork. Decorative accents range from a traditional Chinese carved wood folding room divider to vintage clear pressed glass double candelabras, a brass dragon-handled oil lamp, and a large Indian Kalaga zardozi embroidered wall hanging. Art lovers and collectors will appreciate a framed surrealist landscape oil painting in a gilt frame, an expressionist landscape depicting a gnarled tree, and hand-woven tribal kilim throw pillows paired with rustic terracotta urns.
